name: Train station
description: Two-platform through station: a glazed 24 x 14 m concourse hall raised to platform level behind front steps (ticket office with a counter window, ticket barriers, ticket machines, a departures board), two 56 m platforms with yellow-lined copings and steel canopies, two tracks on ballast with concrete sleepers and rails, and an enclosed footbridge 6 m above the tracks with a two-flight glass-guarded stair down to each platform.
